headline: Alison Hammond 🫀 HEART 💗 CHECK After This Morning 🚪 EXIT
text:
ALISON 🧑‍🦰 HAMMOND 🫶 just got her TICKER 🫀 checked out 🏥 after ditching 🏃 This Morning 📺 midway through the Friday 🗓️ broadcast when she started clutching 👊 her CHEST 🫁 and had to be helped 😣 off set by her regular cohost 🧔 Dermot O'Leary who told viewers 📢 she was feeling a little unwell 🤒 but the 51-year-old 🥳 star posted 📱 a video from her HOSPITAL 🛏️ bed saying she had a little bit of a PALPITATION 💓 during the show yet she is totally FINE ✅ and getting her old ticker 🫀 examined while joking 🃏 that the doctors 👨‍⚕️ are so lovely and everything's gonna be all right 🌟 she thanked viewers 📺 for the lovely messages 💌 while apologizing 🙏 for the dramatic early exit 🚪 saying she would never normally leave a TV show 📺 so you know she wasn't very well 😷 but hopefully she's going to be all right and look how good she looks 💄 still rocking her show makeup 🖌️ while in the hospital bed 🛌.

The Birmingham-born 🎂 presenter who also co-hosts The Great British Bake Off 🍰 was doing her regular Friday slot 🗓️ alongside Dermot O'Leary 🧔 when the episode kicked off at 10am 🕙 BST during a segment about pets 🐶🐱 and she left at 11:30 🕦 appearing to feel off 😣 so Dermot told the audience 📣 Alison is feeling a little unwell so she's had to duck out 🦆 and then later updated that she would not be returning to the show 📺 meaning he would finish the rest of the episode solo 🕴️ she continued in her video 🧥 that it might have been a little panic attack 😟 or something like that but the doctors are checking her out 🩺 and she knows everyone is worried 😟 about her yet honestly she is fine 🟢 and she's rocking it 💃 while still wearing her TV makeup 💄 from the broadcast.

Hammond 🧑‍🦰 first rose to fame on Channel 4's Big Brother 🏠 reality show before appearing on I'm A Celebrity 🏝️ and Strictly Come Dancing 💃 and she became a co-host on This Morning 📺 back in 2021 🗓️ as part of the team that won a National Television Award 🏆 for best daytime programme the following year 📅 and she joined Bake Off 🍰 in 2023 🗓️ and took over from the late Paul O'Grady on For the Love of Dogs 🐕 in 2024 🗓️ while also noting that a Strictly job wouldn't fit into her current schedule 📅 but right now she's focused on getting that heart 🫀 checked properly in the hospital 🏥 after leaving the set so abruptly during the pet segment 🐾.

She assured all her followers 📲 that she is fine 🟢 and getting checked out after leaving ITV's This Morning 📺 midway through the live broadcast 📡 appearing to clutch her chest 🫁 as she was assisted off the set 🛠️ by Dermot who later told viewers she was feeling unwell 🤒 and in her hospital bed video 📹 she said she had a little palpitation 💗 during the show but was feeling OK 👍 and undergoing tests 🧪 while adding that she would never leave a TV show 📺 normally so you know she wasn't very well 😷 but the doctors 👨‍⚕️ are lovely and checking her out thoroughly 🧐 and everything is going to be fine 🌈 as she joked about looking good 💁‍♀️ in her show makeup 🖌️ even from the hospital bed 🛏️.

O'Leary 🧔 and Hammond 🧑‍🦰 are the regular This Morning presenting partnership on Fridays 🗓️ and he addressed her absence 📢 when the show returned from a break ☕ saying welcome back and Alison is feeling a little unwell so she had to duck out 🦆 and hopefully she'll be back but then updated that she would not be returning so he'd be there for the rest of the show 📺 alone and she thanked the viewers for their lovely messages 💌 while apologizing for the dramatic early exit 🚪 and reassured everyone that her old ticker 🫀 is getting checked out properly in hospital 🏥 after that palpitation 💓 moment during the live broadcast 📡 and she hopes it was just a little panic attack 😟 or something like that but overall she is fine 🟢 and rocking it 💃 from her hospital bed 🛌 with full makeup still on 🖌️.

The host 📺 says she is fine but getting checked after leaving midway through Friday's This Morning 📺 and in the video from hospital 🏥 she kept repeating that she knows you're all worried 😟 about me but honestly I am fine 🟢 first of all I'm getting my old ticker checked out 🫀 and I had a little bit of a palpitation 💓 and now I'm getting it all checked out 🧪 but I think I'm OK 👍 and the doctors are so lovely 👨‍⚕️ and they're checking me out thoroughly while she joked about how good she looks 💄 even in the hospital setting 🛏️ after the abrupt departure from the pet segment 🐾 on the ITV show 📺 that she would never normally do so you know it was serious enough to leave 🏃 but everything is going to be fine 🌟.
